facts.fact: 四周后入住：Sean 帮她刷墙收边（sage 色是她的选择）。
facts.anchor: I place the takeout on the counter and walk into my bedroom, where Sean is finishing up the trim on the walls.

facts.fact: 他手搭上她的腰——她呼吸一滞，他察觉后嘴角微微翘起。
facts.anchor: He rests his hand on my hip, holding onto me, as if he’s attempting to not fall over.

facts.fact: 颊吻回礼时他说「You’re welcome, Bee」——她整个人因这个称呼僵住。
facts.anchor: I freeze—my mind and body vibrating at the word.

facts.fact: 搬箱时一箱底部裂开，露出她与 Graham 的合照。
facts.anchor: one of them opened on the bottom

facts.fact: Sean 说「他长得挺帅」——声音像玩笑，眼神发苦。
她坦白：离开过去的生活当然痛；离 moving on 还很远。
facts.anchor: It hurt to leave my life behind. How could it not?

facts.fact: Sean 的等待条款：他可以再等，假设她最终想更进一步。
facts.anchor: Assuming you eventually want to be

facts.fact: 伊拉克往事：他在那里失去了某个人；她按住他的膝盖说改天再讲。
门口惊雷：他承认撒谎——「说我不再爱你那句是假的」，说完低头关门离开。
facts.anchor: His head is looking down at the ground as he walks out the door and shuts it behind him.
